name: Live Build Challenge — vibe coding workshop at NEOMA
description: A free 3-hour vibe coding workshop at NEOMA Reims, co-organised with two friends: find a local business that needs a website, rebuild it with Lovable, pitch it to the owner.
context: Most business students have never built software. We wanted to show that with AI "vibe coding" tools, describing what you want in plain words now gets you a working website, which opens product building to non-developers.
2 April 2026 at NEOMA Business School, Reims, 2 to 6 pm: 3 hours of workshop, plus the welcome and the wrap-up. Free, no technical background needed.

work.title: 3 hours, 3 steps, 1 business
work.text: A real freelance sales cycle, one hour per step:
points: Hunting: find a local business on Google Maps that needs a website.
Build: generate a professional redesign with Lovable (100 credits provided), no code written.
Pitch: contact the owner with the finished site as proof.

work.title: My role
points: Helping organise the event, and setting up the room and equipment.
Leading the opening presentation and facilitation.
Technical help during the build: explaining details and answering participants' questions.

work.title: What students saw
work.text: Behind the visuals, a real code base: components, assets, SEO tags (title, description, Open Graph, structured data), and features like booking that need a back end to go live.

work.title: Takeaway
work.text: AI tools turn an idea into a prototype in an afternoon. The value shifts to picking the problem, giving clear instructions and judging the result.
